intro.fr: Starship Titanic se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Starship Titanic can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP, qui héberge l'APWorld de Starship Titanic.
text.en: The GitHub repository rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP, home of the Starship Titanic APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.2.0.
text.en: The first version, v0.2.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.2.4, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (5 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.2.4 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (5 versions released).

text.fr: Starship Titanic figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Starship Titanic is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
